title: Hot Steamy Japanese Mussels Katsudon
description: Sweet, juicy, pescatarian-friendly dish featuring mussels, steam, and katsudon form, served in a lotus-leaf wrap. Perfect for post-workout rejuvenation.
instructions: Rinse the mussels under cold water and discard any broken shells.
Heat 2 tablespoons of sesame oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add 2 cloves of minced garlic and sauté for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the mussels to the pot and cook for 2-3 minutes until they start to open.
Add 2 tablespoons of soy sauce and 2 tablespoons of rice vinegar to the pot and stir to combine.
Transfer the mussels to a large steamer basket and steam for 4-6 minutes until they are cooked through.
Meanwhile, cook the Japanese short-grain rice according to package instructions.
Prepare the lotus leaves by washing and drying them thoroughly.
Assemble the katsudon by placing a scoop of cooked rice on the center of each lotus leaf, followed by a portion of steamed mussels, and finally a drizzle of soy sauce and rice vinegar.
Garnish with thinly sliced green onions and serve immediately.
